idea-plugin.name: eTamil
idea-plugin.description:
Support for eTamil, a Tamil-vocabulary language for Indian accounting, tax and FinTech.
  • Syntax highlighting, comment toggling and bracket pairing for .qmz files.
  • A run configuration: run, check or serve a .qmz file from the Run menu or Ctrl+Shift+F10.
  • Diagnostics, completion of names in scope, hover and go to definition, from the eTamil language server (etamil-lsp) through LSP4IJ.
The language server must be installed separately and found on the PATH, or named in the ETAMIL_LSP environment variable. See the plugin's documentation.

server.name: eTamil Language Server
server.description: The eTamil language server, etamil-lsp. It answers from the compiler's own front end, so its diagnostics are the ones etamil --check prints.
